init_predictor: initialize a Predictor with a pretrained DocReader model file and optional tokenizer and embedding file
predict_single: predict the answer span for a single document and question pair using the Predictor model
predict_batch: predict answer spans for a batch of document and question pairs with optional candidate tokens
move_to_cuda: move the Predictor model and its underlying DocReader to CUDA GPU memory for faster inference
move_to_cpu: move the Predictor model and its underlying DocReader back to CPU memory from GPU
